source: ECharts 6.1.0 dist (echarts.js) under node, svg, ssr init then _ssr = false, env.node = false
notes: Every option has animation false; the oracle adds nothing to it but a hook on the tooltip view.
hover is handler.findHover after the event; a large element's dataIndex is its ECData's (inner).
The clock moves 1000 ms per step and never back, so the bar throttle always runs at once.

cases.note: bar large: true, 399 rows: one under the default threshold 400 -- normal
bar large: true, 400 rows: the default threshold -- large
bar large: true, 401 rows -- large
bar large: true, 5 rows -- normal
bar large: true, largeThreshold 0, 3 rows -- large
bar large: false, 450 rows -- normal
scatter large: true, largeThreshold 50, 49 points -- normal
scatter, 50 points -- large
scatter, 51 points -- large
scatter large: true, 1999 points: under the default threshold 2000 -- normal
scatter large: true, 2000 points -- large
candlestick, 599 rows: under its default threshold 600 (large is on by default) -- normal
candlestick, 600 rows -- large
candlestick, 601 rows -- large
candlestick large: false, 650 rows -- normal
a line with large: true and largeThreshold 5: the pipeline says large, the line view draws as ever
two large bar series side by side, negative values, the first with a background
horizontal large bars (category y), negative values, a background
two stacked large bar series, mixed signs
barMinHeight 6 with zeros and small values
clip (default true): values past the y max reach above the plot; the group clip cuts the hover there too
clip: false: the same bars, hovered above the plot
a null among large bars: the path bounding rect is not a number and nothing is hovered
barWidth 4 px and a second series at 90%
a slider dataZoom filtering: 30 of 40 large, zoomed to 14 normal, back to 40 large
large scatter on value axes, overlapping points: the scan goes top down
three large scatters: triangle [14, 8], emptyCircle (filled in large), roundRect 12
symbolSize 3: drawn by fillRect; the hit box is 4 wide but the bounding rect only 3
points past the x max: not drawn (the soft clip) but still hovered
clip false: the same points, no soft clip
a null point: the bounding rect is not a number and nothing is hovered
itemStyle border and opacity; a data item with its own colour (large ignores it)
an inside dataZoom on x filtering a large scatter below its threshold and back
a large scatter on a category x with jitter 30: the jittered points are Float32
emphasis: a large scatter next to a line with focus series; hovering the line blurs nothing large; highlight actions do nothing
large candlesticks (threshold 30), own colours: hovering a wick finds an element with no data
borderColorDoji: rows with open = close draw on the third path
an axis tooltip over large candlesticks
a y max under the highs: the group clip cuts the wick and its hover
a category y: upstream stores y twice and draws zero-length wicks
a large bar beside a small one with focus series: hover, highlight, legend hover
